Nc. 101.2.1 (niG-). As cpd. initial takes the form galang- : galan-dunggal big egg. P1: galan-dunggu-runggal-inyung. (-runggal) galam-binyig small egg. (-w2inyig) gala-ma:bu egg. Etym: Probably *ga-galang with *-galang- 'egg' (cf. the present cpd. initial form, also bagalang 'eye' from *baG-galang 'egg of eye'), with *go- either a prefix of some kind or a rdp. segment. Syn: ma:bu (perhaps slightly less common). More specific terms: gayag (bees), lhunugu (fish), ningalang (*ni-galang, turtle).

Nc. 109.3.2 in form (an-)u-mangaj, attested without class prefix as wu-mangaj 109.3.2. (This attesteation, however, could be reanalysed as wu=mangaj 'it is fat'.) HumSg: manga-jung. P1: manga-mangaj. Meaning: generally stresses succulent nature of fat or edible substances of similar consistency, generally a positive expression. Form seems ambiguous as to analysis with root
Nc/Prec spike (hook) on woomera (wandag). As cpd. initial: see =lharba-, =yaba-.
Nc/Pref NCder-dhag end, tip (of object). Cf. -dhig-, -(wl)andhula-. lha:ga- VTrN to set fire to (grass). 16.19.2/3, 55.2.5, 93.1.1, 162.15.4, 166.17.2, 166.19.1. Cf. =na- 'to burn', wurg, =la:dha-.
Nc/Pref taste. As cpd. initial: see mamalang, =ra-wu-, ala:di, w1ayag, w1uril, =yama-. Cf. =ra-wu-.
Nc/Pref(Occurs in my notes as a variant of -manabun-, but probably a mistranscription.)

Nc/Pref(See dhangara). =lhangaraladha-, =lhangaralaladha-, or =lhangirwalaladha- VIntrNgal to have scratches (on one's body); (crocodile, water goanna, etc.) to make 'scratching' marks in mud by moving hands or claws across mud surface. Etym: Probably involves =wlaladha- (rdp. -wala:='ladha-).
Nc/Pref(See ramadhan). Distinct from next entry, below.
Nc/Pref(clear) sky. As cpd. initial: see =rurdi-.
Nc/Pref(outer) shell (of nut, etc., not normally for shellfish). NCder-la. 120.5.2 (ma-la, shell of fruit). In form (an-)u-la, NcAnaWu
Nc/Pref(sharp) stick or branch. As cpd. initial: see =lhaayi-. NCder‚Äë

Nc/Prefappearance, looks, outward aspect. As cpd. initial: see ala:di, ngunyju. ganburg similar in appearance (to someone), the spitting NCQer‚Äë image (of someone). Can take human forms: HumSg: ni-ganbur-jung the spitting image (of some other man). Possibly related to guburg. Cf. ngunyju (and ngunyju-ngunyju).
Nc/Prefblade end of spear shaft. As cpd.
Nc/Prefbundle (wrapped up or swaddled). As cpd. initial: see =yaba-. NCder-garyi. Cf. yigurung.
Nc/Prefcorner. -ngu-gulu. NCder Cpd. initial: see =w2ada-. Cf. -dun-.
Nc/Prefdamper (bread-like substance). This can be made from cycad nuts, water lily seeds, etc., in addition to white man's flour. As cpd. initial: see =nagi-, =ra-.

Nc/Prefdecomposed body or carcass; skeleton with some remains of skin, etc. As cpd. initial: see =lalagi-'- (s.v. =lalaga-). NCder-mabunu. With human referent takes regular number/gender affixes: HumSg: ni-mabun_u-yung (MSg), ngari-mabunu-yung (FSg). P1: (war-)umu:-'-mabunu. Cf. ngagara, badirinTa.
Nc/Prefdoor (or similar object). NC -ngu-dhawang or NC-dhawang Ne. d~TEe second of these forms points to base -lhawang.
Nc/Prefdough, damper; (any) soft, mushy substance. As cpd. initial: see =w2alga-. NCder dany.
Nc/Prefedge (of turtle shell, canoe, or other curved shape. NCde -miyanggara. 166.8.4 (, NcAnaWu). Ct. -midhiginda-.
Nc/Prefend, tip (e.g., of ro e). -7 NC
Nc/Prefexcrement. Common as cpd. initial: see =mamalang-ga-, =na- 'to see', =w2a-, and =yara-. Uncommon as NC

Nc/Preffish trap (dam across creek with hole through which fish swim, being caught in a net or basket). Attested in form NCder-gul only. 108.4.1 (u-gul, Ana class); for Mana form ma-gul see magul (separate listing).
Nc/Prefflames (of fire); firelight. As cpd initial: see lhal-ngargu (below, this page), =yi-wu-, =lhalmba:ra-. For auxiliary cpd. see =lhalm-bu-.

Nc/Prefflesh (of nut or shellfish). As cpd. initial: see =ma-. Possibly also in =winguda- (below). NCder gin. Attested as ma-gin 122.3.3, 156.4.3, and as (war-)u-gin (NcWara) 125.5.4. Usual term for 'flesh' (of animal, etc.): lhanggu. Cf. -w2angidi-.

Nc/Preffood (esp. flour, sugar, porridge, vegetables). Used chiefly as cpd. initial: see =bura-, =na- 'to see', =w2argu-, =w2idhi-, =w2arwargu-. NCder baj. (not common in this form) Competes with -wlanYja- as cpd. initial. Noun: marya.

Nc/Preffood. As cpd. initial in this sense (can be cross-referenced by a more specific noun phrase in the sentence designating a particular plant, animal, etc.): see =bura-, =mamara-, =ngunymaa-, =arawindi-ma- (s.v. arawindi), =yu-. As cpd. initial either with this sense, or as a meaningless filler cpd. initial: see -ari. NCder-ganyja edible part (of plant, etc.). Not common in this form. Cf. marya, dha:gadaj, lhanggu, -w2aj-.
Nc/Preffork in tree (where branches leave trunk). Attested only as NCder-gubaldhar. Cf. munggala.
Nc/Preffur, body hair (rarely) feathers. As cpd. initial: see =w2anja- 'to uproot', =na- 'to burn', =yi-wu-.

Nc/Prefheap. As cpd. initial most often a Multiple (Mult.) prefix with verbs, translatable 'all' (referring to intransitive subject, transitive object, occasionally others, and almost always nonhuman) or 'all over, in several places'; such exx. are listed in the entries for the roots. Sometimes translatable as 'heap' as cpd. initial. Form usually -w1ara-, but there are a few exx. of -wlaraG-, showing hardening of following consonant (see =w2ala-, =wlaya-, =wiuya-). NCder-gara heap, pile (of things). Can also be used occasionally as an emphatic P1. prefix with nouns designating broad flora-fauna categories: ara-ngujija 'lots of/all kinds of fish', with noun-class prefix ana:-'ra-ngujija (see also maingar). Possibly identical to preceding entry (ara).
Nc/Prefhive (of honey bee). Has short vowel as cpd. initial -woman-: see =lha- 'to stand'. Has long vowel as NCder gasman. 143.1.5. Cf. lagu.
Nc/Prefhoney (substance, including honeycomb). Cf. lagu (more general term for honey, honey bees, hives).
Nc/Prefhulk, outer frame (of canoe, coolamon, etc.). NCder-manabun. 166.8.2.
Nc/Prefintestines, entrails. As cpd. initial: see =wlaba-, =ngaingala-.
Nc/Prefnest (esp. of flying fox, occasionally of bird). 1As cpd initial: see =w2udha-.
Nc/Prefnight sky, darkness at night. As cpd. initial: see =a:gi-, =na- 'to see', w2ulunga
Nc/Prefpoint on tree where a branch has been broken off. As cpd. initial: see ngarangara. Ncder-ngu-dumur. Cf. -dhamalang-, miljir.

Nc/Prefprojection, rocks jutting out (over sea). Can be used as cpd. initial: see =jalalaga-. NCder-gunda. (The Wara class form war-u-gunda is used as a place name for a rock projection representing the gilyiringgiyiri people in the Gunabibi mythology.) Cf. =jalalaga-, =ran}'juga-.
Nc/Prefroots (of plant). To be distinguished from -jang (hardened form of ya:ng). NC -ngu-jang roots. Cfde√¢lso wungujang. Cf. -niny-, -nguman-, -lhamuing-, wudan.

Nc/Prefroots of grasses. As cpd. initial may have this meaning but may be used in context of (animal, etc.) having head or other body-part touching or. down near ground (i.e., grass level): see =burda-, =w2anyja-, =wlarda-, =w2aragala-, =yaba-. NC -niny. d~
Nc/Prefsaltwater, sea; (saltwater) surf. As cpd. initial: see =ngarangaralha-. NCder-dhagalg. Attested in form ma-dhagalg NcMana surf splashing
Nc/Prefscraps, bits, pieces; sawdust. NCder-dhawir. Syn: -lhariny-, -wlamuy-.

Nc/Prefscraps, pieces, bits (e.g., of rubbish). Used as cpd. initial, form usuallyw amuy- but occasionally -wlamunY- before a nasal: see =munYmulha-, =ma-. As independent noun can take the form NCder-gamuy, but is more often NCder-gamuymuy with a distinct stem form (showing partial internal reduplication) -wlamuymuy. Syn: -lharinY-, -ngumij-. Cf. a:munY. Possibly related to -w1amuy- (variant -wlamunY-)

Nc/Prefscraps, pieces, bits; sawdust. As cpd. initial: see =yu-. NCder-dharinY pieces, chunks; cuts (of meat). 112.5.5. Has special sense in human forms like MSg ni-dharinY-jung boss, leader. P1: (war-)udhu:-'-dharinY. Syn: bunggawa 'boss', -wlamuy- and -ngumij- 'scraps, pieces'.
Nc/Prefseed(s) (of most plants). Occurs as cpd. initial. NCderdal. Cf. -mundarg-, -jang-, bagalang. Possibly related to =rala-.
Nc/Prefshoot, sprout, small plant. As cpd. initial: see =yu-. NCder-ganung.
Nc/Prefsickness, disease. As cpd. initial: see wlayag.
Nc/Prefsmall leaves of yams and certain other plants including n~uru (Malaisia scandens). NCder-milbarwar. 119.2.5, 119.5.3.
Nc/Prefsmall twigs or sticks (esp. in fire). 2Can be used as cpd. initial. bararg. NCder‚Äë Possibly related to mariyarg.
Nc/Prefsprout, young plant. NCd -dhurubuy. 125.16.4 (NcAna0). ut. -w1ulhunundhunung. =lhurba- VTrNga3 to be friendly with (person), to know (someone) fairly well.
Nc/Prefstem (of a few sedges and similar plants, notably madiga) . As cpd. initial: see =yi- 'to sleep'.

Nc/Prefstem, stalk (of some plants with edible roots including ya:guny, mandhabi, lhawumag, sometimes water lilies) As cpd. initial: see =ara-, =wliinginyja-. NCder-ganang. 114.1.5 (Ana class), 114.9.2 (Mana). Cf. -w1alar-, -w2al-. ‚Ä¢

NCder-bal. 108.1.1/2 (ni-bal), 115.1.6 (ma-bal). Cf. ab-a-1 , madbal. ala Particle all right? (Tag-question form after imperative or suggestion, designed to elicit addressee's agreement; discussed in Grammar.) Cf next entry.
Nc/Prefsticky substance (such as honey or nectar). As cpd. initial: see =yu-.
Nc/Prefthick honey (part of honey as taken from hive). As cpd. initial: see =ma-, =yarawa-.
Nc/Prefthorn;sRlinter. As cpd initial: see =n argiwa-. NCder-dhawal, unmarked form (an-)u-dhawal NcAnaWu.
Nc/Preftrack, trace, mark (of something). As cpd. initial: see =lharma-, =murgulha-, =na- 'to see'. NCder-mari.
Nc/Preftubers on roots of certain sedges such as madiga. NCder-dhamuing, attested in form ma-dhamuing. Cf. la:n (ma-lan).
Nc/Prefwind (air current). (Agreement usually AnaWu). lhangun mawura:duj cold wind. lhanguny-badawadad strong wind.
Nc/Prefwound, surface injury; scar, welt. As cpd. initial: see =mula-, =w2al-bu-.
Nc/Prefyam, taproot (edible part of root of such plants as lhawumag, ri:ja, and yanyjug).
NcAna( a fish, said to be the young of yalabura. 64.8.4.
NcAna( antelopine kangaroo, Macropus antelopinus. (uncommon) Syn: arjambal (common), etc.

NcAna( tern sp. or spp. (usually larger than those called garanjimala). 18.7.4(song, but also used as regular word). Syn: gigiwu. Cf. garanjimala, wurumbangana. girjag! Interjection No! 4.2.5, 11.5.2, etc. Cf. -ari, yagi (other negatives; see discussion in Grammar). gi=wa- VTrNga3 (See =w2a-). giya! Interjection look out!, watch out! Pronounced with' interjection lengthening as giyao:::! or the like; also rdp. giya-giyao:::!
NcAna(?) what?, something (unknown). (Sense not clear). gabigabi, NcNgara
NcAna(Adv) (for a) long time. 48.1.4, 139.8.2. Syn: ada:bilhangu. Cf. also w2uguwuguni. For sense 'long time ago' a demonstrative form o:-'ba-ni-yung-gaj is used.

NcAna(Adv) (for a) short time. 97.4.1. (ma1G-). Fact.: =dhamungur-wa-, Pl. Object -dhama=lhamungur-wa-. Note: Variant form with g (dhamungurg) also recorded. Syn: dhamurug (less common), -mulumulubug.
NcAna(Adv) (for) illicit sex, elopement. 44.1.2, 45.1.2, 79.2.3. Ex: wini=ya-nggi wumangumangu 'They(MDu, i.e., man and woman) went off to have a sexual affair'. Cf. -nguniny-.
NcAna(Adv) (in the) middle; sea not far from coast (cf. creole "middle water" in this sense). 9.2.4, 65.14.5, 95.9.2, 113.5.5(sea). bandhara-wala-yaj along the coast. 29.4.1/3. Cf. alagala, w2ulunga.

NcAna(Adv) (in the) north. 125.9.4, 125.13.1, 163.20.3. Rdp: wunu-wunumbi (far) in the north. Allative: wunumbi-yaj northward. 18.8.5, 18.6.5, 47.1.2, 97.7.1, 166.7.3. Ablative: wunumbi-yala from the north. 20.10.5, 20.6.3, 161.30.1, 166.19.2.
NcAna(Adv) (on) one side. 111.4.8. yamar-libilibala, NcAna(Adv). (on) one side.
NcAna(Adv) (on) one side. Ex: nga=ya-nggi birina 'I went along on one side'. birir! (sound of twigs and leaves being crunched underfoot, etc.). 43.11.6. Cf. mariyarg.
NcAna(Adv) (on) the far side. 13.1.3, etc. Belongs to a special reduplicated demonstrative construction discussed in Grammar.
NcAna(Adv) (well) to the south (locative). 47.21.4. Related to waga-y, wagi-yaj, wagi-yangu.

NcAna(Adv) a short time from now (just before or soon after); nearly, almost, on the verge of. 1.1.2, 109.3.1, 125.1.3, 126.4.1, 139.1.2, 140.3.4, 161.9.3, etc. Discussed more fully in Grammar. Cf. adaba, mal-dhamungur (s.v. lhamungur).

NcAna(Adv) all the way (to destination). (fairly uncommon) Ex. adaba lhuga:guj nga:mbu=ya:-ri: 'Now we(InPl) will go all the way (there)'. Variant: lhuga:guny. Rdp. lhugu-lhuga:guj, lhugu-lhuga:guny also used in same sense. Less common than expressions with verb =w ala- 'to arrive' or simple deictic adverbs like yu:-gu-ni *to there'. Cf. also next entry, below.
NcAna(Adv) all the way (to destination). Cf. lhuga:guj.

NcAna(Adv) behind, (coming) later, at end (of moving group). Ex: wu:=ya-nggi amagari 'They went along behind'. Less common than adha:dhari, cf. also =lhamara-. Possibly related to cpd. initial -gari-. Opposite: ragij and related forms.

NcAna(Adv) calm, still (water, etc.). Ex: ma:-'r=yi-nga-nY adaba mana-lhagayag nawululumbululu 'Now the sea has become calm'. Cf. =da:dha- and synonyms, =mudadba-. of lha:ny). NCder form *niG- plus *-lhamung, ‚Ä¢

NcAna(Adv) east, in the east. rama-ramali (far) in the east. 16.15.4, 16.19.1, 18.9.2, 40.1.8. ramali:-'la from the east. 46.1.6, 166.21.1. ramali-yaj (going) to the east, eastward. 27.2.2, 71.11.3, 167.10.1(misglossed as place name in last ex.) Cf. argali, wunumbi, wagi-.
NcAna(Adv) entirely, every bit, all the way. (uncommon).
NcAna(Adv) first (in a place or to do something). 5.7.5, 10.1.1, 15.4.1, 20.5.2, 27.3.5, 33.1.3, 55.5.3, 161.6.2, 161.8.3, 161.15.1. ragij-gaj (with Pergressive case suffix). 7.6.4.
NcAna(Adv) for a while. 7.3.4. Ex: nga=ya:-ri: adhuwayung ngijang ngand=a:gi-ny 'I am going (away) for a while, (then) I will come back again'. Cf. lhamungur (mal-dhamungur).
NcAna(Adv) for nothing; anyway. (not common) Cf. arbidi. argi NcAnaO loose possessions (bedding, etc.). 146.1.2/3. Cf. ngurji., NAdj

NcAna(Adv) forcefully, vigorously, hard. 1.9.2, 18.9.2, 43.7.1, 66.2.6, 73.8.3, 162.8.2. Ex: angudu ba=yambi:-na 'Speak (more) loudly!' Possible segmentation a-ngudu suggested by occurrence of NCder-ngudu, attested as (an-)u-ngudu-ruj 'deeply (into country)" 21.1.3. (However, a- in a-ngudu is not the Ana class prefix.) Cf. angadajung, lhu:d.
NcAna(Adv) from the south. 18.13.3, 47.20.6, 52.4.4, 166.13.3, 166.22.1. Related to wagi-yaj, waga-y, waga-waga. Ends in irregular ablative suffix.

NcAna(Adv) hike, walkabout. Ex. of instrumental: nga:rnbu=ya:-ri: bari-miri 'Let's go for a walk, Let's go walkabout'. As cpd. initial: see ngulungulug, w alwal, =ngawi-'‚Äë Syn: lharug. Cf. also some entries below, this page.
NcAna(Adv) how much?, how many? 125.16.4. lhal-ngargu, NcAna(Adv) when? (-lhaing-) NCder-ngargu, Nc

NcAna(Adv) in the west. 143.12.8, 162.4.2. Often in rdp. form arga:-'rgali (often heard as argargali) '(far) in the west'. 13.6.1, 33.3.1, 16.18.3, 40.2.4, 117.4.6. argali-nyi westward, (going) to the west. 16.13.4, 20.14.6, 29.6.5, 47.1.2, 113.4.6. argali:-'la (coming) from the west. 52.4.5. arga:-'rgali-yaj along through the west. 40.3.2.
NcAna(Adv) leeward, downwind, (going) with the wind (sailing term). Opposite: bi:lu. Ex: yagi num=bayami-o ana-bi:lu, dhu:ru barra=wagiwa-ng 'Do not sail into the wind, turn it (boat) leeward!'
NcAna(Adv) long time, (for) a long time. Related to preceding entry. Cf. badag, w2uguwuguni.

NcAna(Adv) nevertheless, anyway; in no special way, in just any way; of just any type, not special; haphazardly, without much attention. 57.3.1/3, 68.1.6, 71.32.1, 73.7.1, 84.1.3, 87.1.6, 106.4.2, 112.6.2. Cf. argargayag.

NcAna(Adv) on the side, along the side. Ex: ni=ya-nggi li:ngu 'He went along the side (of something)'. yamar-li:n u NcAna(Adv) on or along the side. ma-lingu-miri (looking) askance, from the side. (NC
NcAna(Adv) or (rarely), NAdj, NAdj), 170.2.1. arwagarwar-(w)ala-(w)aj (going along) on top. 43.2.1, 43.4.4, 163.8.6. As cpd. final: see magulag. Etym: irregular rdp. of arwar (q.v.).
NcAna(Adv) or NACU to there, (going) that way. Adverbial sense common (see grammar).
NcAna(Adv) outside, in the open. (not common) Cf. mawungarara, arari.
NcAna(Adv) quick(ly), immediate(ly), in a hurry. 10.12.1, 40.14.3, 111.5.2pred, 111.5.2/3, 45.10.7. Ex: ngalbalang ba=ya:-ri: 'Go quickly!' Cf. ngulungulug.
NcAna(Adv) quick(ly), immediate(ly). Ex: many=ja:-ri: adaba ngany=jalgu 'I will go right away'. As adverb also yaljalgu-waj. =yaljira VIntrNgal to be hanging up, to be suspended., VTrA2

NcAna(Adv) softly, lightly, delicately (in context of touching, etc.). Cf. also arwar-(w)aj in preceding entry. Opposite: angudu, lhu:d. w2 arwarNcNa thick low stringybark (E. tetradonta) scrub. 8.1.4, 40.3.4, 162.20.3. Cf. num-barwar for a related form and relevant discussion. Place name yi:-warwar-(y)inyung means '(place) of warwar'.
NcAna(Adv) southward, toward the south. 13.6.1, 20.1.6, 20.4.6, 25.2.4, 33.2.4, 47.1.2. Cf. waga-y, waga-waga, wagi-yangu.

NcAna(Adv) southward. 18.8.6, 163.20.3. Cf. waga-waga, wagi-yaj, wagi-yangu. =agi- VTrI1 to go and collect (people, money, foods, etc.--most often people, for ritual). 47.16.2, 48.2.2, 55.2.3, 115.5.6, 163.17.4. Syn: =manda:gi- (perhaps *-man- plus *=agi-). Easily confusable with next entry, cf. also =aga:gi-.
NcAna(Adv) that way, to there, thither. With noun-class prefix: an-u-guni. Discussed in Grammar.
NcAna(Adv) this kind of thing. Discussed in Grammar (chapter on demonstratives).

NcAna(Adv) today; now, nowadays; the same day (as something else). 47.8.3, 47.10.5, 61.2.4, 73.2.2, 97.3.3, 118.2.4, 161.10.1, 161.10.2, 164.3.4, 164.4.2. mal-jimba(j)-duj these days, at the present time. 108.8.3 (-ma1G-)
NcAna(Adv) tomorrow; the next day (after some other reference time). 47.19.1, 47.12.6, 52.5.1, 164.1.1. Cf. yimbaj, agalgi.
